title: Welcome to MarkdownX
p: Give your ideas a place to grow, from a quick note to an interactive book. These guides are ordinary documents: edit or delete them whenever you like.

callout.p: Reading is local. No account or cloud workspace: the MarkdownX library stays in ~/Documents/MarkdownX.

p: Press ⌘ N and give the page a title. Then work through this list; click a checkbox to mark it complete.
checkbox: Type / on an empty line and insert a table
Select a word and press ⌘ B to make it bold
p: My documents shows the MarkDown-Demo folder inside your system Documents folder. Use the + beside My documents to add folders; their trees remain visible together. Each folder’s … menu can change its name or location, refresh it, or remove it from the list without deleting files. Pinned pages can appear below the folder trees. Home lists recent library pages; search all locations with ⌘ K.
Distinct icons and colors identify folders and file types. Open other file types from their … menu using your system app.

The interface switches between English and Simplified Chinese in Settings › General. A book can carry both languages too: the browser reader shows content_en when the reader chooses English, while the desktop library keeps the primary text.

The default library is ~/Documents/MarkdownX. Each library page is XML under docs; images and attachments live under assets. Back up the whole library folder. The My documents folder is separate and contains your Markdown files.
